summary: BCE Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 7, 2026, reporting the voting results of its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held that same day. The filing details the election of 13 directors with strong shareholder support (votes for ranging from 97.98% to 99.10%), the appointment of Ernst & Young LLP as auditors (99.46% votes for), an advisory vote on executive compensation (96.00% votes for), and a shareholder proposal on increasing AGM participation (defeated with 98.16% against). This is a routine disclosure of standard meeting outcomes with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, activist campaign, or management change. The filing is procedural under Canadian continuous disclosure obligations, equivalent to a U.S. Form 8-K Item 5.07.
